map.选择多肉品种与季节，推荐浇水频率并支持记录每次浇水时间、到期自动提醒，避免烂根或: Choose the succulent species and season to get a recommended watering frequency, with each watering recorded and an automatic reminder when the next one is due, avoiding rot or drought. For succulent hobbyists keeping a regular care routine.

map.区分冬型种（如生石花）与夏型种（如仙人掌、芦荟）的相反浇水节奏。: Distinguishes winter-growing types (such as lithops) from summer-growing types (such as cacti and aloe), which have opposite watering rhythms.
map.：石莲花 10/15/10/25；十二卷 12/20/12/30；景天 8/12: : intervals by species in spring/summer/autumn/winter days — Echeveria 10/15/10/25; Haworthia 12/20/12/30; Sedum 8/12/8/20; Aloe 15/10/15/30; cactus 15/10/15/40; Crassula 10/18/10/25; Kalanchoe 10/15/10/20; Euphorbia 12/10/12/30; Lithops 15/30/12/40; Gasteria 14/20/14/30. Next watering date = last watering date + the days for the matching season.
map.：石莲花在春季每 10 天浇一次，上次 3 月 1 日则下次 3 月 11 日；: : Echeveria is watered every 10 days in spring, so after March 1 the next is March 11; in summer it stretches to 15 days, so after June 1 the next is June 16. Cacti are the opposite: every 10 days in the growing summer, stretching to every 40 days in winter dormancy, almost dry.
map.多数多肉（石莲花、景天、生石花等）夏季高温休眠，根系吸水弱，盆土长期潮湿极易黑腐: Most succulents (Echeveria, Sedum, Lithops, and similar) go dormant in hot summer with weak root uptake, so persistently wet soil easily causes black rot; cut water and improve ventilation and shade.
map.芦荟、仙人掌为什么夏季浇水更勤？: Why Do Aloe and Cacti Need More Frequent Watering in Summer?
map.它们属夏型种，夏季为生长旺季需水较多；冬季低温休眠则要严格控水，避免低温高湿导致: They are summer-growing types: summer is the peak season and needs more water, while winter dormancy at low temperature requires strict water control to avoid freeze damage and rot.
